scoring_justification: Full recompute of observables requires rerunning MD simulations; infeasible in verifier sandbox; scoring structural trends as defined by the paper's description of Op(T) and cV(T) curves.

outputs.description: CSV file with temperature-dependent observables (cluster counts, largest cluster size, orientational order parameter, specific heat) for the flat surface (toroidal boundary conditions).
CSV file with temperature-dependent observables for the spherical surface (spherical boundary conditions).

output_contract.notes: The agent must produce both CSV files. The structural checker will verify qualitative trends (sharpness of Op rise, number of c_V peaks) without requiring bit-level agreement with the paper's exact numerical values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold structural thresholds and peak count criteria for Op(T) and cV(T) curves from flat and spherical surfaces.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper figures and text: Fig.7,9 for TBC peaks and Op; Fig.13,15 for SBC peaks and Op; discussion in Sec. III.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted quantitative bounds and peak criteria directly from paper descriptions.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All thresholds are the reported observed ranges and trends for the two topologies; no external hidden file is needed.
